scope: A curated UK smoke-ventilation collection: AOV control-panel installation and user instructions, configuration/menu references and wiring guides. Brand grouping is navigation, not a declaration of component compatibility or a complete brand inventory. Region, installed variant and latest edition still need checking in the original document.
gaps: Group SCS: current IP54 and legacy EV panel generations remain separate. Seven official links were identified, but direct retrieval returned HTTP 202 HTML; they are recorded in the source audit and excluded from complete-file counts.
Colt and Adexon: no usable manufacturer manual was verified in this batch.
Custom Electronics includes two image-only guides; visual identity was checked, but searchable text/OCR is not claimed.
No complete inventory of every UK brand, product, firmware or historical edition is claimed.
